# Technical info {#sec-technical-information}

## Docker image {#sec-docker-image}

A `Docker` image built from this repository is available here:

👉 [ghcr.io/microbiome/oma](https://ghcr.io/microbiome/oma) 🐳

::: {.callout-tip icon='true'}
## Get started now 🎉

You can get access to all the packages used in this book in < 1 minute,
using this command in a terminal:

```{sh, filename="bash"}
#| label: docker
#| eval: false

docker run -it ghcr.io/microbiome/oma:devel R
```

:::

## RStudio Server {-}

An RStudio Server instance can be initiated from the `Docker` image as follows:

```{sh, filename="bash"}
#| label: rstudio
#| eval: false

docker run \
    --volume <local_folder>:<destination_folder> \
    -e PASSWORD=OMA \
    -p 8787:8787 \
    ghcr.io/microbiome/oma:devel
```

The initiated RStudio Server instance will be available at
[http://localhost:8787](http://localhost:8787).

## Session info {#sec-session-info}

```{r}
#| label: book_info
#| echo: false
intro <- tryCatch(
    {
        description <- packageDescription("OMA")
        pkg <- description$Package
        version <- description$Version
        authors <- eval(parse(text = description[["Authors@R"]]))
        license <- description$License
        glue::glue(
            "**Package:** {pkg}<br/>\n",
            "**Authors:** {
                # Named authors, followed by a link to the full list of
                # contributors instead of the and-others placeholder
                others <- grepl('contributors', format(authors))
                named <- authors[!others] |>
                    format(include = c('given', 'family')) |>
                    paste(collapse = ', ')
                if (any(others)) {
                    named <- paste0(
                        named, ', and ',
                        '[other contributors](contributions.qmd)'
                    )
                }
                named
            }<br/>\n",
            "**Compiled:** {as.character(Sys.Date())}<br/>\n",
            "**Package version:** {version}<br/>\n",
            "**R version:** {R.version.string}<br/>\n",
            "**BioC version:** {BiocManager::version()}<br/>\n",
            "**License:** {license}<br/>"
        )
    },
    error = function(e) {
        "Local preview"
    }
)
```


`r intro`

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

## Click to expand 👇

```{r}
#| label: session_info
#| cache: false

sessioninfo::session_info(
    installed.packages()[, "Package"],
    include_base = TRUE
)
```
